title.zh: 雲芝糖肽，到底對身體有什麼好處？
title.en: What does Yunzhi PSP actually do for the body?

text.zh: 雲芝糖肽是從雲芝提取的精華，由多糖與蛋白肽結合而成。它並非直接治病的西藥，而是像為身體加裝護盾，透過激活免疫細胞來增強抵抗力、輔助頑症治療以減輕副作用、保護肝臟及抗疲勞。
text.en: Yunzhi PSP is an essence extracted from the Yunzhi mushroom, formed from polysaccharides combined with protein peptides. It is not a Western medicine that treats illness directly; it is more like fitting the body with a shield, activating immune cells to strengthen resistance, supporting cancer treatment so as to ease side effects, protecting the liver and countering fatigue.

title.zh: 90%的惡性腫瘤患者死於癌症復發！這五大長生存「秘籍」快收藏
title.en: 90% of malignant tumour patients die of recurrence! Five keys to long-term survival worth saving

text.zh: 頑症復發主因包括治療不徹底、療法侷限、微轉移及癌細胞休眠，高峰期為術後1-3年。患者可透過心理、營養、免疫、腸道菌群及運動五大調節方式，增強免疫力，降低復發風險。
text.en: The main causes of recurrence include incomplete treatment, the limits of a given therapy, micrometastasis and dormant cancer cells, with the peak period one to three years after surgery. Patients can raise their immunity and lower the risk of recurrence through five kinds of adjustment: psychological, nutritional, immune, gut microbiome and exercise.

title.zh: 惡性腫瘤疾病為何捲土重來？揭密復發原因與因應之道
title.en: Why do malignant tumours come back? The causes of recurrence, and how to respond

text.zh: 惡性腫瘤復發的原因複雜，手術雖能切除腫瘤，但微轉移細胞、腫瘤幹細胞及不良微環境可能導致復發。免疫系統在抗癌中至關重要，失衡時癌細胞乘虛而入。有效預防復發需透過術後輔助治療、免疫重建和生活方式干預。
text.en: The causes of malignant tumour recurrence are complex. Surgery can remove the tumour, but micrometastatic cells, tumour stem cells and an unfavourable microenvironment may all lead to recurrence. The immune system is critical in resisting cancer, and when it is out of balance cancer cells take advantage. Preventing recurrence effectively calls for post-operative adjuvant treatment, immune rebuilding and lifestyle intervention.

text.zh: T3的抗氧化能力比一般維他命E強40到60倍，能有效清除體內的自由基，減少皺紋和曬斑，讓皮膚更緊緻、光彩照人。此外還能保護腦細胞，幫助預防阿爾茨海默症，促進記憶力。
text.en: T3's antioxidant capacity is 40 to 60 times that of ordinary vitamin E. It clears free radicals from the body effectively, reducing wrinkles and sun spots and leaving the skin firmer and more radiant. It also protects brain cells, helping to prevent Alzheimer's disease and supporting memory.

title.zh: 身體的「清道夫」，就是你抗癌的第一道防線！
title.en: The body's “scavengers” are your first line of defence against cancer

text.zh: 巨噬細胞是人體免疫系統的核心防禦力量，能吞噬病原體與異常細胞。研究顯示雲芝糖肽（PSP）可有效激活巨噬細胞，增強其清除能力並調節免疫反應，幫助身體重建防禦屏障。
text.en: Macrophages are the core defensive force of the human immune system, engulfing pathogens and abnormal cells. Research shows that Yunzhi PSP can effectively activate macrophages, strengthening their clearing capacity and regulating the immune response, helping the body rebuild its defensive barrier.

title.zh: 雲芝多糖能恢復受損的免疫功能！
title.en: Yunzhi polysaccharides can restore damaged immune function

text.zh: 雲芝的核心價值在於其活性成分「多糖肽」（PSP/PSK），一方面強效激活巨噬細胞、NK細胞等免疫機能，另一方面直接誘導癌細胞凋亡並抑制腫瘤血管生成，是恢復受損免疫功能的關鍵輔助利器。
text.en: Yunzhi's core value lies in its active component, the polysaccharide peptides PSP/PSK. On one hand they powerfully activate immune functions such as macrophages and NK cells; on the other they directly induce apoptosis in cancer cells and inhibit tumour angiogenesis, making them a key adjuvant tool for restoring damaged immune function.

title.zh: 雲芝糖肽的全面健康效益
title.en: The full health benefits of Yunzhi PSP

text.zh: 雲芝糖肽（PSP）是從雲芝提取的精華，由多糖與蛋白肽結合而成，非直接治病，而是為身體建立防護盾。增強免疫力、輔助癌症治療減輕副作用、保護肝臟及抗衰老，適合作為長期調養的天然保健選擇。
text.en: Yunzhi PSP is an essence extracted from the Yunzhi mushroom, formed from polysaccharides combined with protein peptides. It does not treat illness directly but builds a protective shield for the body: strengthening immunity, supporting cancer treatment so as to ease side effects, protecting the liver and countering ageing. It suits long-term care as a natural health choice.

title.zh: 天然維生素E之王！ 1粒T3等於10倍抗氧化，吃下凍齡腦力
title.en: The king of natural vitamin E! One T3 capsule for 10x the antioxidant power, and brainpower that stays young

text.zh: 三烯生育醇（T3）是比常見α-生育酚更優越的「抗衰黃金」。其抗氧化力是普通維他命E的60倍，且為100%天然提取。T3能有效護心腦、增強免疫，結合雲芝糖肽（PSP）更能相輔相成。
text.en: Tocotrienols (T3) are the “anti-ageing gold” that outperforms the more common alpha-tocopherol. Their antioxidant power is 60 times that of ordinary vitamin E, and they are 100% naturally extracted. T3 effectively protects the heart and brain and strengthens immunity, and works all the better in combination with Yunzhi PSP.

title.zh: 從宮廷禦藥到對抗惡性腫瘤的先鋒
title.en: From imperial court medicine to the front line against malignant tumours

text.zh: 雲芝自古為宮廷御藥，現代研究證實其核心成分雲芝多糖（PSK/PSP）具卓越免疫調節作用。透過激活樹突細胞、巨噬細胞等免疫哨兵，多靶點抑制癌細胞增殖與轉移。
text.en: Yunzhi has been an imperial court medicine since ancient times, and modern research confirms that its core component, Yunzhi polysaccharide (PSK/PSP), has outstanding immune-regulating effects. By activating immune sentinels such as dendritic cells and macrophages, it inhibits the proliferation and metastasis of cancer cells through multiple targets.

title.zh: 每天認識一味中藥：雲芝－腫瘤患者的天然守護者
title.en: A Chinese herb a day: Yunzhi, the natural guardian of tumour patients

text.zh: 雲芝糖肽（PSP）被譽為「腫瘤患者天然守護者」，能直接抑制癌細胞生長、阻斷腫瘤血管，同時激活自然殺手細胞與T細胞，輔助放化療減輕副作用，臨床證實可提高生存率。
text.en: Yunzhi PSP is known as the “natural guardian of tumour patients”. It can directly inhibit the growth of cancer cells and block tumour blood vessels, while activating natural killer cells and T cells; it supports radiotherapy and chemotherapy by easing side effects, and has been clinically shown to improve survival rates.

title.zh: 外泌體療法在帕金森氏症的研究中展示了顯著的治療效果
title.en: Exosome therapy shows significant therapeutic effect in Parkinson's disease research

text.zh: 此療法有效清除腦內有害物質，阻止α-突觸核蛋白異常堆積。同時外泌體能夠降低發炎因子，促進神經修復，活化多巴胺神經元的再生。臨床試驗顯示運動功能和生活品質均有明顯改善。
text.en: This therapy effectively clears harmful substances from the brain and halts the abnormal accumulation of alpha-synuclein. Exosomes can also lower inflammatory factors, promote nerve repair and reactivate the regeneration of dopamine neurons. Clinical trials show clear improvements in both motor function and quality of life.
